title: Boho Summer Hairstyle Clipart Bundle - Beach Hair PNG Elements - Commercial Use
description_html:
Get ready for sunny days with our Boho Summer Hairstyle Clipart Bundle! This trendy collection features 12 beautifully illustrated summer hair elements, perfect for celebrating beach days and warm weather vibes.

You will receive 12 high-resolution transparent PNG files (300 DPI), including effortless messy buns, beach waves, claw clip updos, dutch braids, and must-have summer hair accessories like scrunchies, wide-tooth combs, and sea salt spray. Designed in a cohesive boho pastel color palette of peach, sun-yellow, soft teal, and terracotta.

These versatile graphics are perfect for creating custom planner stickers, salon promotional materials, party invitations, scrapbooking layouts, and print-on-demand products like tote bags or tumblers.

Features:

  • 12 individual transparent PNG files
  • High-quality 300 DPI resolution
  • Instant digital download
  • Commercial use friendly

Upgrade your summer crafting projects with these gorgeous, easy-to-use summer hairstyle illustrations today!
